G0200.def:
ἀκρίς, -ίδος, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for אַרְבֶּה, also for חָגָב, etc. ;] 
a locust: Matthieu 3:4, Marc 1:6, Apocalypse 9:3, 7.†

G0201.def:
ἀκροατήριον, -ου, τό
(ἀκροάομαι, to listen) 
a place of audience: Actes 25:23 (Plut.).†

G0202.def:
ἀκροατής, οῦ, ὁ (see supr.) 
[in LXX: Ésaïe 3:3 (לַחַשׁ), Sir.3:29 ;] 
a hearer: Romains 2:13, Jacques 1:22, 23, 25.†

G0203.def:
ἀκροβυστία, -ας, ή
(perh. an Alexandrian form of cl. ἀκροποσθία; cf. MM, VGT, see word) [in LXX for עׇרְלָה ;] 
the prepuce, foreskin (LXX), hence abstr., uncircumcision: Actes 11:3, Romains 2:25-27 3:30 4:10-12, 1 Corinthiens 7:18-19, Galates 5:6 6:15, Colossiens 2:13 3:11 By meton., the uncircumcised: Romains 4:9, Galates 2:7, Éphésiens 2:11.†

G0204.def:
ἀκρο-γωνιαῖος, -αία, -αῖον
(ἄκροι, γωνία, an angle) [in LXX: Ésaïe 28:16 (פִּנָּה) * ;] = Attic γωνιαῖος (frequently in Inscr.; MM, VGT, see word ἀ.), 
at the extreme angle: ὁ ἀ., the corner foundation stone, Éphésiens 2:20, 1 Pierre 2:6.†

G0205.def:
ἀκροθίνιον, -ου, τό
(ἄκρος, θίς, a heap), 
prop., the top of a heap, hence, in pl., 
__1. first-fruits (Xen.; MM, VGT, see word). 
__2. In war, the choicest spoils (cf. Hdt., viii, 121 f.): Hébreux 7:4.
†

G0206.def:
ἄκρος, -α, -ον 
[in LXX for קֶצַח, בֹּהֶן, etc. ;] 
highest, extreme; as subst., τὸ ἄ., the top, extremity: Marc 13:27, Luc 16:24, Hébreux 11:21; pl. (cf. MM, VGT, see word), Matthieu 24:31.†

G0207.def:
Ἀκύλας, -ου (and -α; MM, VGT, see word), ὁ (Lat.), 
Aquila: Actes 18:2, 18 18:26, Romains 16:3, 1 Corinthiens 16:19, 2 Timothée 4:19.†

G0208.def:
ἀκυρόω, -ῶ
(κῦρος, authority), [in LXX: 1Es.6:32 Esther 6:1-34, 2Ma.6:1-31 * ;] 
to revoke, invalidate (MM, VGT, see word): Matthieu 15:6, Marc 7:13, Galates 3:17 (Plut.).†

G0209.def:
ἀκωλύτως 
adv. (κωλύω), [in Sm.: Job 34:31 * ;] 
without hindrance (so frequently in legal documents; MM, VGT, see word): Actes 28:31.†

G0210.def:
ἀκων (Attic contr. for ἀέκων), -ουα, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ἅκων, willing), [in LXX: Job 14:17, 2Ma.11:12 * ;] 
unwilling: 1 Corinthiens 9:17.†

G0211.def:
ἀλάβαστρον, -ου, τό (also -ος, ὁ, ἡ; colloq. and κοινή for ἀλάβαστος), 
[in LXX: 4Ki.21:13 (צַלַּחַת)* ;] 
a box of alabaster (ἀλαβαστίτης) for ointment: Matthieu 26:7, Marc 14:3, Luc 7:37 (see DCG, i, 41b; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0212.def:
ἀλαζονία(Rec. -εία, the earlier form), -ας, ἡ 
(ἀλαζών), [in LXX: Wis.5:8 17:7, 2; 4Ma.5:1-38 * ;] 
the character of an ἀλαζών, boastfulness, vainglory, vaunting: Jacques 4:16 (Mayor, in l), 1 Jean 2:16.†

G0213.def:
ἀλαζών, -όνος, ὁ, ἡ
(ἄλη, wandering) [in LXX: Job 28:8 (שַׁחַץ) Habacuc 2:5 (יָהִיר), Proverbes 21:24 (לוּץ)* ;] 
prop, a vagabond, hence, an impostor, a boaster: Romains 1:30, 2 Timothée 3:2.†
SYN.: ὐβριστής, ὑπερήφανος (see Tr., Syn., § xxix; Lft., Notes, 256)

G0214.def:
ἀλαλάζω
(onomat. from the battle-cry ἀλαλά), [in LXX chiefly for רוּעַ hi., יָלַל ;] 
prop, to raise a war-cry, shout with triumph or joy; rarely of grief, to wail: Marc 5:38 (cf. Jérémie 4:8); of a cymbal, ἀλαλάζον (RV. clanging), 1 Corinthiens 13:1 (cf. ὀλολύζω).†

G0215.def:
ἀ-λάλητος, -ον
(λαλέω), 
inexpressible, not to be uttered: Romains 8:26.†

G0216.def:
ἄ-λαλος, -ον
(λάλος, talkative), [in LXX: Psaumes 31:18 (אָלַם ni.) Psaumes 38:13 (אִלֵּם)* ;] 
dumb, speechless: Marc 7:37 9:17, 25.†

G0217.def:
ἅλας (T, ἅλα), -ατος, τό, late form of cl. ἅλς, -ος, ὁ (MM, VGT, see word), 
[in LXX chiefly for מְלַח ;] 
salt, lit, and figuratively: Matthieu 5:13, Marc 9:50 Luc 14:34; like cl. ἅλες, wit, of wisdom and grace in speech: Colossiens 4:6.†

G0218.def:
ἀλείφω
(cf. λίπος, oil), [in LXX: Genèse 31:13, Exode 40:15, Nombres 3:3 (מָשַׁח), Eze.13:10 ff. (טוּחַ), Ruth 3:3, 2 Rois 12:20 14:2, 4Ki.4:2, 2 Chroniques 28:15, Michée 6:15, Dan LXX TH Daniel 10:3 (סוּךְ), Esther 2:12, Jdth.16:8 * ;] 
to anoint, festally or in homage: with accusative of thing(s) or of person(s), Matthieu 6:17, Jean 12:3, Marc 16:1; before dative, ἐλαίῳ, Marc 6:13, Jacques 5:14; μύρῳ, Luc 7:38, 46, Jean 11:2.†
SYN.: χρίω, μυρίζω (against the distinction made bet. ἀ. and χ. in Tr., Syn., § 38, see MM, VGT, see word, ἀ.)

G0219.def:
ἀλεκτοροφωνία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀλέκτωρ, φωνή), 
cock-crowing, i.e. the third watch in the night: Marc 13:35.†

G0220.def:
ἀλέκτωρ, -ορος, ὁ
(poët. form of ἀλεκτρυών; see MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX: Proverbes 30:31) (זַרְזִיר; BDB, Lex., 267)* ;] 
a cock: Matthieu 26:34, Marc 14:30, 68 14:72 Luc 22:34, 60-61, Jean 13:38 18:27.†

G0222.def:
Ἀλεξανδρινός (Rec. -δρῖνο; see Kühner3, II, 296), -ή, -όν, 
Alexan­drian: Actes 27:6 28:11.†

G0223G.def:
Ἀλέξανδρος, -ου, ὁ, 
Alexander 
__1. Son of Simon of Cyrene: Marc 15:21 
__2. A kinsman of the High Priest: Actes 4:6. 
__3. A certain Jew: Actes 19:33. 
__4. A coppersmith: 1 Timothée 1:20. 
__5. Perh. = 4 (see Ellic. on I Ti, l.with): 2 Timothée 4:14.
†

G0223H.def:
Ἀλέξανδρος, -ου, ὁ, 
Alexander 
__1. Son of Simon of Cyrene: Marc 15:21 
__2. A kinsman of the High Priest: Actes 4:6. 
__3. A certain Jew: Actes 19:33. 
__4. A coppersmith: 1 Timothée 1:20. 
__5. Perh. = 4 (see Ellic. on I Ti, l.with): 2 Timothée 4:14.
†

G0223I.def:
Ἀλέξανδρος, -ου, ὁ, 
Alexander 
__1. Son of Simon of Cyrene: Marc 15:21 
__2. A kinsman of the High Priest: Actes 4:6. 
__3. A certain Jew: Actes 19:33. 
__4. A coppersmith: 1 Timothée 1:20. 
__5. Perh. = 4 (see Ellic. on I Ti, l.with): 2 Timothée 4:14.
†

G0223J.def:
Ἀλέξανδρος, -ου, ὁ, 
Alexander 
__1. Son of Simon of Cyrene: Marc 15:21 
__2. A kinsman of the High Priest: Actes 4:6. 
__3. A certain Jew: Actes 19:33. 
__4. A coppersmith: 1 Timothée 1:20. 
__5. Perh. = 4 (see Ellic. on I Ti, l.with): 2 Timothée 4:14.
†

G0224.def:
ἄλευρον, -ου, τό
(ἀλεύω, to grind), [in LXX for קֶמַח, Nombres 5:15, al. ;] 
real: Matthieu 13:33, Luc 13:21.†

G0225.def:
ἀλήθεια, -ας, ἡ 
(ἀληθής), [in LXX chiefly for אֱמֶת (on which, see Cremer, 627f.), אֱמוּנָה ;] 
truth (see DB, iv, 818f.). 
__1. Objectively, "the reality lying at the basis of an appearance; the manifested, veritable essence of a matter" (Cremer, 86): Romains 9:1, al.; of religious truth, Romains 1:25, al.; esp. of Christian doctrine, Galates 2:5, al.; ἀ. θεοῦ, Romains 15:8. 
__2. Subjectively, truthfulness, truth, not merely verbal (cl.), but sincerity and integrity of character: Jean 8:44, 3Jo.3. 
__3. In phrases (MM, VGT, see word): ἐπ᾽ ἀληθείας, Marc 12:14, al.; ἀ. λέγειν (εἰπεῖν, λαλεῖν), Romains 9:1, 2 Corinthiens 12:6, Éphésiens 4:25, al.; ἀ. ποιεῖν, Jean 3:21, 1 Jean 1:6 (cf. DB, iv, 818b, ff.).

G0226.def:
ἀληθεύω
(ἀληθής), [in LXX: Genèse 20:16 (יָכַח) Genèse 42:16 (אֶמֶת), Proverbes 21:3 (מִשְׁפָּט), Ésaïe 44:26 (שָׁלַם), Sir.34:4 * ;] 
to speak the truth (R, mg., deal truly; Field, Notes, 192): Galates 4:16, Éphésiens 4:15.†

G0227.def:
ἀληθής, -ές
(λήθω = λανθάνω, hence primarily, unconcealed, manifest; hence, actual, real), [in LXX for אֶמֶת, etc. ;] 
__(a) of things, true, conforming to reality: Jean 4:18 5:31-32 6:55 (= ἀληθινός, which see) Jean 8:13-14, 17 10:41 19:35 21:24, Actes 12:9, Philippiens 4:8, Tite 1:13, 1 Pierre 5:12, 2 Pierre 2:22, 1 Jean 2:6, 3Jn.12; 
__(b) of persons, truthful: Matthieu 22:16, Marc 12:14, Jean 3:33 7:18 8:26, Romains 3:4, 2 Corinthiens 6:8.†
SYN.: ἀληθινός, real, genuine, ideal, as opposite to spurious or imperfect ἀληθής, true to fact, as opposite to false, lying, denotes the actuality of a thing: ἀληθινός, its relation to the corresponding con­ception. (Cf. Tr., Syn., § viii; Cremer, 84 f., 631 Abbott, JV, 234 f.; DB, iv, 818 f.; MM, VGT, s.vv.)

G0228.def:
ἀληθινός, -ή, -όν
(ἀληθής), [in LXX for אֶמֶת ;] 
true, in the sense of real, ideal, genuine: Luc 16:11 Jean 1:9 4:23, 37 6:32 7:28 8:16 15:1 17:3 19:35, 1 Thessaloniciens 1:9, Hébreux 8:2 9:24 10:22, 1 Jean 2:8 Jn 5:20, Apocalypse 3:7, 14 6:10 15:3 16:7 19:2; = ἀληθής, Apocalypse 19:9 21:5 22:6 (MM, VGT, see word).†
SYN.: ἀληθής, q.v

G0229.def:
ἀλήθω
(κοινή form of the Attic ἀλέω), [in LXX for טָחַן ;] 
to grind: Matthieu 24:41, Luc 17:35.†

G0230.def:
ἀληθῶς 
adv. (ἀληθής). [in LXX (Jérémie 28:6, Psaumes 58:1, al.) chiefly for אָמֵן and cogn. forms ;] 
truly, surely: Matthieu 14:33 26:73 Marc 14:70 15:39, Luc 9:27 12:44 21:3, Jean 1:48 4:42 6:14 7:26, 40 8:31 17:8 Actes 12:11, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:13, 1 Jean 2:5.†

G0231.def:
ἁλεεύς (Rec. ἁλιεύς, the older form; WH, App., 151, -έως, ὁ 
(ἅλς, the sea) [in LXX for דָּג, דַּוָּג ;] 
a fisherman: Matthieu 4:18, 19, Marc 1:16, 17, Luc 5:2

G0232.def:
ἁλιεύω
(ἁλιεύς), [in LXX: Jérémie 16:16 (דִּיג)* ;] 
to fish: Jean 21:3 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0233.def:
ἁλίζω
(ἅλς), [in LXX for מָלַח ;] 
to salt, season with salt: Matthieu 5:13, Marc 9:49.†

G0234.def:
ἀλίσγημα, -τος, τό 
(late ἀλισγέω, to pollute) 
pollution: Actes 15:20.†

G0235.def:
ἀλλά (ἀλλ᾽ usually bef. α and υ, often bef. ε and η, rarely bef. ο and ω, never bef. ι; Tdf., Pr., 93 f.; WH, App., 146), 
adversative particle, 
stronger than δέ; prop. neuter pl. of ἄλλος, used adverbially, with changed accent; hence prop. otherwise, on the other hand (cf. Romains 3:31); 
__1. opposing a previous negation, but: οὐ (μὴ) . . . ἀ., Matthieu 5:15, 17 Marc 5:39, Jean 7:16, al.; rhetorically subordinating but not entirely negativing what precedes, οὐ . . . ἀ., not so much . . . as, Marc 9:37, Matthieu 10:20, Jean 12:44, al.; with ellipse of the negation, Matthieu 11:7-9, Actes 19:2, 1 Corinthiens 3:6 6:11 7:7, 2 Corinthiens 7:1, Galates 2:3, al.; in opposition to a foregoing pos. sentence, ἀ. οὐ, Matthieu 24:6, 1 Corinthiens 10:23; οὐ μόνον . . . ἀ. καί, Jean 5:18, Romains 1:32, al.; elliptically, after a negation, ἀ. ἵνα, Marc 14:49, Jean 1:8 9:3, al.; = εἰ μή (Bl., §77, 13; M, Pr., 241; but cf. WM, §iii, 10), Matthieu 20:23, Marc 4:22. 
__2. Without previous negation, to express opposition, interruption, transition, etc., but: Jean 16:20 12:27, Galates 2:14; before commands or requests, Actes 10:20 26:16, Matthieu 9:18, Marc 9:22, al.; to introduce an accessory idea, 2 Corinthiens 7:11; in the apodosis after a condition or concession with εἰ, ἐάν, εἴπερ, yet, still, at least, Marc 14:29, 1 Corinthiens 9:2, 2 Corinthiens 4:16, Colossiens 2:5, al.; after μέν, Actes 4:17, Romains 14:20, 1 Corinthiens 14:17; giving emphasis to the following clause, ἀλλ᾽ ἔρχεται ὥρα, yea, etc., Jean 16:2; so with neg., ἀλλ᾽ οὐδέ, nay, nor yet, Luc 23:15. 
__3. Joined with other particles (a practice which increases in late writers; Simcox, LNT, 166), ἀ. γε, yet at least, Luc 24:21, 1 Corinthiens 9:2; ἄ ἤ., save only, except, Luc 12:51, 2 Corinthiens 1:13; ἀ. μὲν οὖν, Philippiens 3:8 (on this usage, see MM, VGT, see word).

G0236.def:
ἀλλάσσω
(ἄλλος), [in LXX chiefly for חָלַף, מוּר hi., etc. ;] 
__1. to change: Actes 6:14, Galates 4:20. 
__2. to transform: 1 Corinthiens 15:51-52, Hébreux 1:12. 
__3. to exchange: with accusative, before ἐν (= בְּ, Psaumes 106:20) instead of simple genitive (Bl., § 36, 8), Romains 1:23 
(cf. ἀπ-, δι-, κατ-, ἀπο-κατ-, μετ-, συν-αλλάσσω; see MM, VGT, see word).†

G0237.def:
ἀλλαχόθεν 
adv. (ἀλλος), [in LXX: 4Ma.1:7 * ;] = ἀλλοθεν (seeMM, VGT, see word) 
from another place: Jean 10:1.†

G0238.def:
ἀλληγορέω, -ῶ
(ἄλλος, ἀγορεύω) 
to speak allegorically (Cremer, 96 ff.): Galates 4:24.†

G0239.def:
ἁλληλουιά
(Rec. ἀλληλούϊα; Heb. הָלַל יָהּ, praise the Lord), [in LXX in the titles of certain Psa (104 (105), al.), and at the end of Psaumes 150:1-6; also Tob.13:18, 3Ma.7:13 ;] 
hallelujah, alleluia: Apocalypse 19:1, 3-4 19:6.†

G0240.def:
ἀλλήλων (genitive pl.), dative -οις, -αις, accusative -ους, -ας, -α (no nom.), recipr. pron. 
(ἄλλος), 
of one another, mutually: Matthieu 25:32, Marc 4:41, Jean 13:22, al.

G0241.def:
ἀλλογενής, -ές
(ἄλλος, γένος), [in LXX chiefly for זוּר, נֵכָר ;] 
of another race, a foreigner ( = ἀλλόφυλος; Cremer, 150; MM, VGT, see word): Luc 17:18.†

G0242.def:
ἅλλομαι 
[in LXX for צָלַח, דָּלַג pi., etc. ;] 
to leap: Actes 3:8 14:10; of water, to spring up, Jean 4:14 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0243.def:
ἄλλος, -η, -ο, (cf. Lat. alius, Eng. else), 
[in LXX for אַחֵר ,אֶחָד, etc. ;] 
other, another: absol., Matthieu 20:3, al.; ἄ. δέ, 1 Corinthiens 3:10 12:8; pl., Marc 6:15; attached to a noun, Matthieu 2:12 4:21, al.; with art., ὁ ἄ., the other, Matthieu 5:39, Jean 19:32 (Bl., §47, 8); οἱ ἄ., the others, the rest, Jean 20:25, 1 Corinthiens 14:29; ἄ. πρὸς ἄλλον = πρὸς ἀλλήλους (BL, §48, 10), Actes 2:12; ἄλλ᾽ (i.e. ἄλλο) ἤ (Bl., §77, 13), Luc 12:51; before πλήν, Marc 12:32; εἰ μή, Jean 6:22; παρά with accusative, 1 Corinthiens 3:11.
SYN.: ἕτερος, which see ἄ. denotes numerical, ἕ. qualitative difference (Cremer, 89). ἄ. generally "denotes simply distinction of individuals, ἕ. involves the secondary idea of difference in kind" (see Lft., Meyer, Ramsay, on Galates 1:6, 7; Tr., Syn., §xcv; BL, §51, 6; M, Pr., 79f., 246; MM, VGT, s.vv.). As to whether the distinction can be maintained in 1 Corinthiens 12:8, 10 see ICC, in l., and on Hébreux 11:35f., see Westc, in l.

G0244.def:
ἀλλοτρι-επίσκοπος (Rec. ἀλλοτριοεπ-), -ου, ὁ 
one who meddles in things alien to his calling: 1 Pierre 4:15 (see ICC, in l; Deiss., BS, 224-4; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0245.def:
ἀλλότριος, -α, -ον
(ἄλλος), [in LXX for זוּר, נֵכָר, אַחֵר ;] 
__1. be-longing to another, not one's own (opposite to ἴδιος): Luc 16:12, Romains 14:4 15:20 (Field, Notes, 165 f.), 2 Corinthiens 10:15-16, 1 Timothée 5:22, Hébreux 9:25. 
__2. foreign, strange, alien (opposite to οἰκεῖος; see MM, VGT, see word): Matthieu 17:25-26, Jean 10:5, Actes 7:6, Hébreux 11:9, 34.†

G0246.def:
ἀλλόφυλος, -ον
(ἄλλος, φῦλον, a tribe), [in LXX chiefly for פְּלֶשֶׁת ;] 
foreign, of another race (MM, VGT, see word); as opposite to a Jew, a Gentile: Actes 10:28.†

G0248.def:
ἀλοάω, -ῶ
(ἅλως, see: ἅλων; and cf. MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX chiefly for דּוּשׁ ;] 
to thresh: 1 Corinthiens 9:9 9:13; 1 Timothée 5:18.†

G0249.def:
ἄ-λογος, -ον 
[in LXX: Exode 6:12 (שָׂפָה עָרֵל), Nombres 6:12 (נָפַל), Job 11:12, Wis.11:15-16, 4Ma.3:1-21 * ;] 
__1. without reason, irrational: ζῷα, 2 Pierre 2:12, Ju 10. 
__2. contrary to reason: Actes 25:27 (see MM, VGT, see word).†

G0250.def:
ἀλόη, -ης, ἡ 
[in LXX: Cantique des cantiques 4:14 א (אֲהָלִים)* ;] 
the aloe, aloes (the powder of a fragrant wood): Jean 19:39.†

G0251.def:
ἅλς, ἁλός, ὁ
variant for ἅλας (which see): Marc 9:49, Rec. WH, mg., R, mg.†

G0252.def:
ἁλυκός, -ή, -όν
(ἅλς), [in LXX for מְלַח, שִׂדִּים ;] 
salt: Jacques 3:12.†

G0254.def:
ἅλυσις, -εως, ἡ 
[in LXX: Wis.17:17 * ;] 
a chain, bond: Marc 5:3-4, Luc 8:29, Actes 12:6-7 21:33 28:20, Éphésiens 6:20, 2 Timothée 1:16, Apocalypse 20:1.†

G0257.def:
ἅλων, -ωνος
(for Attic ἅλως, -ω, see MM, VGT, see word), ἡ, [in LXX chiefly for גֹּרֶן ;] 
a threshing floor: Matthieu 3:12, Luc 3:17 (here prob. by meton. = the grain on the threshing floor).†

G0258.def:
ἀλώπηξ, -εκος, ἡ 
[in LXX for שׁוּעָל ;] 
a fox: Matthieu 8:20, Luc 9:58; metaphorically, of Herod, Luc 13:32.†

G0259.def:
ἅλωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἁλίσκομαι), [in LXX: Jérémie 50:46 (תָּפַשׂ ni.)* ;] 
a taking, capture: 2 Pierre 2:12.†

G0260.def:
ἅμα 
adv., 
at once (Lat. simul): Actes 24:26 27:40, Romains 3:12 (one and all = יַחַד, Psaumes 14:3), Colossiens 4:3, 1 Timothée 5:13, Phm 22; before σύν, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:17 5:10; as prep. with dative, together with: Matthieu 13:29 (see MM, VGT, see word); also, with adv., ἅ. πρωΐ (cl., ἅ. ἕω, etc.), early in the morning: Matthieu 20:1.†

G0261.def:
ἀμαθής, -ές
(μανθάνω), [in Sm.: Psaumes 49:11 * ;] 
unlearned, ignorant: 2 Pierre 3:16 (on the rareness of this word, see MM, VGT, see word).†

G0262.def:
ἀμαράντινος, -ον
(ἀμάραντος), 
of amaranth (Inscr.); hence un­fading: 1 Pierre 5:4.†

G0263.def:
ἀμάραντος, -ον
(μαραίνομαι), [in LXX: Wis.6:12 (σοφία)* ;] 
un­fading (whence ὁ ἀ., the amaranth, an unfading flower): 1 Pierre 1:4 (cf. MM, VGT, see word).†

G0264.def:
ἁμαρτάνω
(present formed from aor. ἁμαρτεῖν), [in LXX for חָטָא, also for אָשַׁם, רָשַׁע, etc. ;] 
__1. to miss the mark (Hom., Æsch., al.), hence metaphorically (Hom., al.), to err, do wrong 
__2. In LXX and NT, to violate God's law, to sin (for non-Christian exx., see MM, VGT, see word): absol., Matthieu 18:25 27:4, Luc 17:3, Jean 5:14 8:11 9:2-3 Romains 2:12 3:23 5:12, 14 5:16 6:15, 1 Corinthiens 7:28 7:36 15:34, Éphésiens 4:26, 1 Timothée 5:20, Tite 3:11, Hébreux 3:17 10:26, 1 Pierre 2:20, 2 Pierre 2:4 2:4 1 Jean 1:10 Jn 2:1 Jn 3:6-9 Jn 5:18; with cogn. accusative, ἁ. ἁμαρτίαν (cf. Exode 32:30, חֲטָאָה חָטָא), 1 Jean 5:16; before εἰς, Matthieu 18:21, Luc 15:18, 21 17:4, Actes 25:8 (καίσαρα). 1 Corinthiens 6:18 8:12 (Field, Notes, 173); ἐνώπιον, Luc 15:18, 21; πρὸς θάνατον (cf. Nombres 18:22, מוּת חֵטְא), 1 Jean 5:16 (Cremer, 98, 633).†

G0265.def:
ἁμάρτημα, -τος, τό
(ἁμαρτεῖν, see supr.), [in LXX for חַטָּאָה, עָוֺן etc. ;] 
an act of disobedience to divine law (Lft., Notes, 273), a sinful deed, a sin: Marc 3:28-29, Romains 3:25, 1 Corinthiens 6:18, 2 Pierre 1:9, WH, mg.; αἰώνιωv ἀ. (DCG, i, 788a), Marc 3:29 (for exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word).†
SYN.: ἀγνόημα, ἁμαρτία, ἀνομία, ἀσέβεια, ἥττημα, παράβασις, παρακοή, παρανομία, παράπτωμα (ν. Cremer, 100; Tr., Syn., § lxvi; DB, iv, 532; DCG, l.with; Westc, Eph., 165 f.)

G0268.def:
ἁμαρτωλός, -όν
(ἁμαρτάνω), [in LXX chiefly for רָשָׁע ;] 
sinful, a sinner: of all men, 1 Timothée 1:15; of those especially wicked, 1 Timothée 1:9, 1 Pierre 4:18; p1., Matthieu 9:10-13 11:19 26:45, al. (see MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 102, 634)

G0269.def:
ἄμαχος, -ον
(μάχη); 
__1. invincible (frequently in cl.). 
__2. abstaining from fighting, non-combatant (Xen.). Metaphorical (cf. MM, VGT, see word), not contentious: 1 Timothée 3:3, Tite 3:2.†

G0270.def:
ἀμάω, -ῶ
(in cl. chiefly poët.), 
to reap: Jacques 5:4.†

G0271.def:
ἀμέθυστος, -ου, ἡ
(accusative to Plut., ἀ- μεθύω, being regarded as an antidote against drunkenness) [in LXX: Exode 28:19 36:19 39:12 Eze.28:13 * ;] 
amethyst, a purple quartz: Apocalypse 21:20.†

G0272.def:
ἀμελέω, -ῶ
(μέλει), [in LXX: Jérémie 4:17 (מָרָה) Jérémie 31:32 (בַּעַל), Wis.3:10, 2Ma.4:14 * ;] 
__(a) absol., to be careless, not to care: Matthieu 22:5; 
__(b) with genitive, to be careless of, to neglect: 1 Timothée 4:14, Hébreux 2:3 8:9 (see MM, VGT, see word).†

G0273.def:
ἄ-μεμπτος, -ον
(μέμφομσι), [in LXX chiefly for תָּם ;] 
blameless, free from fault (in π. of a marriage-contract; M, Th., I, 3:13; cf. MM, VGT, see word): Luc 1:6, Philippiens 2:15 3:6, 1 Thessaloniciens 3:13 (WH, mg., -ως) Hébreux 8:7.†
SYN.: ἄμωμος, ἀνέγκλητος, ἀνεπίλημπτος, which see (Tr., Syn., § ciii)

G0274.def:
ἀ-μέμπτως, 
adv. (ἄμεμπτος), [in LXX: Esther 3:13 * ;] 
blamelessly (Lft., Notes, 28, 89; MM, VGT, see word -ος): 1 Thessaloniciens 2:10 3:13 WH mg., 5:23.†

G0275.def:
ἀμέριμνος, -ον
(μέριμνα), [in LXX: Wis.6:15 7:23 * ;] 
free from anxiety or care: Matthieu 28:14, 1 Corinthiens 7:32 (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).†

G0276.def:
ἀ-μετάθετος, -ον
(μετατίθημι), [in LXX: 3Ma.5:1 3Mac 5:12 * ;] 
immutable: Hébreux 6:18; as subat., τὸ ἀ., immutability, Hébreux 6:17 (see MM, VGT, see word).†

G0278.def:
ἀ-μεταμέλητος, -ον
(μεταμέλομαι), 
not repented of, unregretted: Romains 11:29, 2 Corinthiens 7:10.†

G0279.def:
ἀμετανόητος, -ον
(μετανοέω) 
__1. impenitent: Romains 2:5 
__2. = ἀμεταμέλητος (π., Philo, al.; see Deiss., BS, 257; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0280.def:
ἄμετρος, -ον
(μέτρον), 
without measure: adverbially, εἰς τὰ ἄ., excessively, 2 Corinthiens 10:13 10:15†

G0281.def:
ἀμήν, indecl. (Heb. אָמֵן, verbal adj. fr. אמן, to prop. ni., be firm), 
[in LXX: 1 Chroniques 16:36, I Esther 9:46, Néhémie 5:13 8:6, Tob.8:8 14:15, 3Ma.7:23, 4Ma.18:24 (elsewhere ''א is rendered ἀληθινός, Ésaïe 65:16; ἀληθῶς, Je 35 (28):6; γένοιτο, Nombres 5:22, Deutéronome 27:15ff., 3Ki.1:36, Psa.40 (41):13 71 (72):19 105 (106):48, Jérémie 11:5)*.] 
__1. As adj. (cf. Is, l.with), ὁ ἀ., Apocalypse 3:14. 
__2. As adv., 
__(a) in solemn assent to the statements or prayers of another (Nu, Ne, etc., ll. with): ὁ ἀ., 1 Corinthiens 14:16; 
__(b) similarly, at the end of one's own prayer or ascription of praise: Romains 1:25 15:33, Galates 1:5, 1 Timothée 1:17; 
__(with) in the Gospels, exclusively, introducing solemn statements of our Lord, truly, verily: Matthieu 5:18, 26 Marc 3:28 (see Swete, in l.), Luc 4:24, al.; ἀ. ἀ., always in Jean 1:52 3:3 5:19, al.; τὸ ναί, καὶ . . . τὸ ἀ., 2 Corinthiens 1:20 (on usage in π., see MM, VGT, see word).

G0282.def:
ἀμήτωρ, -ορος, ὁ, ἡ
(μήτηρ), without a mother (frequently in Gk. writers of the gods): ἀπάτωρ ἀ. 
of one without recorded genealogy, Hébreux 7:3 (cf. MM, VGT, see word)

G0283.def:
ἀ-μίαντος, -ον
(μιαίνω), [in LXX: Wis.3:13 4:2 8:20, 2Ma.14:36 2Mac 15:34 * ;] 
undefiled, free from contamination (in π., of αἰθήρ; MM, VGT, see word): Hébreux 7:26 13:4, 1 Pierre 1:4, Jacques 1:27.†
SYN.: ἄμωμος, ἄσπιλος (Cremer, 784)

G0284.def:
Ἀμιναδάβ, ὁ indecl. (Heb עַמִּינָדָב), 
Amminadab: Matthieu 1:4, Luc 3:33 (WH om.).†

G0285.def:
ἄμμος, -ου, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for חוֹל ;] 
sand, sandy ground: Matthieu 7:26, Romains 9:27, Hébreux 11:12, Apocalypse 18:1, Apocalypse 20:8.†

G0286.def:
ἀμνός, -οῦ, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for כֶּבֶשׂ ;] 
a lamb: figuratively, of Christ (DCG, ii, 620b), Jean 1:29, 36, Actes 8:32" (LXX), 1 Pierre 1:19 (cf. ἀρνίον; Cremer, 102, 635).†

G0287.def:
ἀμοιβή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀμείβομαι, to repay); [in Aq., Sm.: Proverbes 12:14, al. ;] 
requital, recompense: 1 Timothée 5:4 (for illustration from τ.. see MM, VGT, see word).†

G0288.def:
ἄμπελος, -ου, ἡ 
[in LXX for גֶּפֶן ;] 
vine: Matthieu 26:29, Marc 14:25, Luc 22:18 Jacques 3:12; figuratively, of Christ, Jean 15:1, 4-5; of his enemies (on the usage here, see MM, VGT, see word): Apocalypse 14:18-19.†

G0289.def:
ἀμπελουργός, -οῦ, ὁ, ἡ 
[in LXX for כֹּרֵם ;] 
a vine dresser: Luc 13:7.†

G0290.def:
ἀμπελών, -ῶνος, ὁ
(ἄμπελος), [in LXX for כֶּרֶם ;] 
a vineyard: Matthieu 20:1 ff. Matthieu 21:28 ff, Luc 13:6 20:9 ff., 1 Corinthiens 9:7. Æschin., 49, 13; Diod., al.; see MM, VGT, see word; LS, see word ἀμπελουργεῖον.)

G0291.def:
Ἀμπλιᾶτος (T, -ίατος; Rec. Ἀμπλιᾶς; see MM, VGT, 5.see), -ου, ὁ 
Ampliatus: Romains 1:6 8:8.†

G0293.def:
ἀμφίβληστρον, -ου, τό
(ἀμφιβάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for חֵרֶם ;] 
something thrown around, as a garment; spec., a casting-net: Matthieu 4:18.†

G0294.def:
ἀμφιέννυμι
(ἕννυμι, to clothe), 
to clothe: Matthieu 6:30 11:8, Luc 7:25 (cf. ἀμφιάζω).†

G0295.def:
Ἀμφίπολις, -εως, ἡ 
Amphipolis, in Macedonia, so called because the river Strymon flowed around it: Actes 17:1.†

G0296.def:
ἄμφοδον, -ου, το
(ἀμφί ὁδός), [in LXX for אַרְמוֹן (Jérémie 17:27 30:10 49:27)* ;] 
prop., a road around anything (RV, the open street): Marc 11:4, Actes 19:28, WH, mg.†

G0297.def:
ἀμφότεροι, -αι, -α
(replaces ἄμφω in κοινή, V. M, Pr., 57; used of more than two, Pr., 80; MM, VGT, see word), both of two: Matthieu 9:17, al.

G0298.def:
ἀ-μώμητος, -ου
(μωμάομαι), 
blameless: 2 Pierre 3:14.†
SYN.: ἄμεμπτος (which see), ἀνέγκλητος, ἀνεπίλημπτος

G0299.def:
ἄ-μωμος, -ον
(μῶμος, which see), [in LXX chiefly for תָּמִים ]; 
of sacrificial victims, without blemish: of Christ, Hébreux 9:14, 1 Pierre 1:19; etbically, unblemished, faultless: Éphésiens 1:4 5:27, Philippiens 2:15, Colossiens 1:22, Ju 24, Apocalypse 14:5 (Cremer, 425, 788; MM, VGT, see word).†
SYN.: ἀμίαντος, ἄσπιλος
